summary: The note describes the Acura EL, a subcompact executive car produced at Honda's Alliston, Ontario, plant. It is noted as the first Acura built in Canada. The EL is described as a badge-engineered Honda Civic offering a higher level of features.
one_line: The Acura EL is a subcompact executive car built in Alliston, Ontario, as a badge-engineered, upscale Honda Civic.
key_facts: The Acura EL is a subcompact executive car.
The Acura EL was built at Honda's Alliston, Ontario, plant.
The Acura EL was the first Acura built in Canada.
The Acura EL is a badge-engineered Honda Civic.
The Acura EL offers a higher level of features than the Honda Civic it is based on.
